cases.tensor_convention: N[i][j][k] is the coefficient of X_k in X_i * X_j. Indices are zero-based; X_0 is the unit. The supplied source basis is preserved.

exact_character_presentation.exact_generator: theta = Σ_i w_i X_i (character value at a root of P)
exact_character_presentation.instruction: For each complex root θ of P(θ)=0, substitute θ into the displayed polynomials to obtain one exact irreducible character and its formal codegree. All matrix identities N_i=p_i(H) were checked over Q.

invariants.exact_dimension_method: Each FP dimension is the largest real root of its displayed irreducible polynomial, isolated by the rational interval. Factors and intervals are computed exactly from the integral fusion-matrix characteristic polynomial. The global dimension uses the central Casimir matrix.
invariants.fusion_matrix_convention: N_i[j][k] = N[i][j][k]; rows are the right input basis index, columns are the output basis index.
invariants.closed_based_subrings_method: Exhaustive subsets containing the unit, closed under duality and every nonzero fusion-product coefficient. Includes the unit subring and the whole ring.

categorification_scope.record_scope_note: The complete C2 Fourier-packing criterion excludes all sixteen second-indicator branches, covering both pointed associators. The independently verified general-to-Galois-pseudo-unitary reduction makes this an exclusion of every complex fusion categorification.

braided.explanation: A pseudo-unitary braiding would have symmetric center Rep(C2) or sVec. In both cases the reduced codegree identity forces a squared simple dimension D/10=54+24sqrt(5), which is absent from the tensor. Every general categorification has a pseudo-unitary Galois conjugate, and any braiding transports to it. The exclusion therefore requires no initial pivotal structure.

morita.explanation: Every proper fusion subcategory is pointed and the global FP dimension is irrational. A braided Morita representative would therefore give a braiding on this category, by the tensor-image criterion. Hence no categorification of this ring is Morita equivalent to a braided fusion category.

invariants.dimensions_method: Numerical Perron eigenvector, normalized at the tensor unit; approximate values.
invariants.character_method: Numerical simultaneous eigencharacters of the integral fusion matrices; approximate values.

exact_character_presentation.exact_generator: theta = Σ_i w_i X_i (character value at a root of P)
exact_character_presentation.instruction: For each complex root θ of P(θ)=0, substitute θ into the displayed polynomials to obtain one exact irreducible character and its formal codegree. All matrix identities N_i=p_i(H) were checked over Q.

invariants.exact_dimension_method: Each FP dimension is the largest real root of its displayed irreducible polynomial, isolated by the rational interval. Factors and intervals are computed exactly from the integral fusion-matrix characteristic polynomial. The global dimension uses the central Casimir matrix.
invariants.fusion_matrix_convention: N_i[j][k] = N[i][j][k]; rows are the right input basis index, columns are the output basis index.
invariants.closed_based_subrings_method: Exhaustive subsets containing the unit, closed under duality and every nonzero fusion-product coefficient. Includes the unit subring and the whole ring.

construction_notes: Exact cyclic-unit reconstruction of all24 source fusion matrices from the fundamental graph and its transpose, followed by all512 neutral tensor coefficients.
The permutation identifies every source-neutral fusion coefficient with the canonical census tensor.
cases.summary: A unitary categorification is identified: the eight-object triality-zero component of the E21 exceptional fusion category from the conformal embedding SU(3)_21 into E7_1. All 512 fusion coefficients match the census tensor. The algebra 1+X5 and both nonregular based-module types are realized. Braided categorification and braided Morita representatives remain excluded. Every Morita partner has the same based fusion ring, without a rank or multiplicity cutoff.

same_category_implications.explanation: The complete oriented sphericalization analysis forces a spherical section: all other signed quotients are excluded by exact dimension-character obstructions, or the positive second-indicator normalization leaves only the original tensor.
